stormraven-gunship.name: Stormraven Gunship
stormraven-gunship.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly <Chapter> Infantry models and 1 friendly <Chapter> Dreadnought. Each Jump Pack, Wulfen, or Terminator model takes the space of 2 other Infantry models, and each Centurion model takes the space of 3 other Infantry models. It cannot transport Primaris units.

storm-eagle-assault-gunship-roc-pattern.name: Storm Eagle Assault Gunship - ROC Pattern

profiles.name: Storm Eagle Assault Gunship - ROC Pattern

storm-eagle-assault-gunship-roc-pattern.transport: This unit can transport up to 14 friendly MINOTAURS INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models, each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

options.name: Bolt Rifles and Close Combat Weapons

and-they-shall-know-no-fear.name: And They Shall Know No Fear
and-they-shall-know-no-fear.text: Re-roll failed Morale tests taken for ADEPTUS ASTARTES units in this Detachment.

omni-scramblers.name: Omni-scramblers
omni-scramblers.text: Enemy units cannot be set up within 12" of this unit during the Set Up Reinforcements step.

aquilon-optics.name: Aquilon Optics
aquilon-optics.text: When this unit makes a Shoot action, if it has remained stationary or moved a distance less than half its Move characteristic this turn, double the Attacks characteristic of its Heavy Laser Destroyer and Macro Plasma Incinerator for that action.

explorator-augury-web.name: Explorator Augury Web
explorator-augury-web.text: Enemy units cannot be set up within 12" of this unit during the Set Up Reinforcements step.

battle-auspex.name: Battle Auspex
battle-auspex.text: This unit does not suffer the penalty for attacks made with ranged weapons that target obscured targets.

rolling-thunder.name: Rolling Thunder
rolling-thunder.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit with its Punisher Rotary Cannon.

unstoppable-fury.name: Unstoppable Fury
unstoppable-fury.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit with melee weapons whilst it is equipped with 2 Dreadnought Combat Weapons.

unstoppable-fury-2.name: Unstoppable Fury
unstoppable-fury-2.text: If this unit is equipped with two melee weapons, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit with melee weapons.

helical-targeting-array.name: Helical Targeting Array
helical-targeting-array.text: When this unit makes a Shoot action, if it has remained stationary this turn, add the Anti-air ability to its weapons for that action.

atomantic-pavaise.name: Atomantic Pavaise
atomantic-pavaise.text: Add 1 to saving throws made for <CHAPTER> units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly <CHAPTER> units that have an Atomantic Pavaise.

atomantic-pavaise-2.name: Atomantic Pavaise
atomantic-pavaise-2.text: Add 1 to saving throws made for BLOOD ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly BLOOD ANGELS units that have an Atomantic Pavaise.

atomantic-pavaise-3.name: Atomantic Pavaise
atomantic-pavaise-3.text: Add 1 to saving throws made for DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly DARK ANGELS units that have an Atomantic Pavaise.

atomantic-pavaise-4.name: Atomantic Pavaise
atomantic-pavaise-4.text: Add 1 to saving throws made for SPACE WOLVES units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly SPACE WOLVES units that have an Atomantic Pavaise.

projected-void-shields.name: Projected Void Shields
projected-void-shields.text: Improve the Save characteristic (to a maximum of 3+) of friendly units by 1 whilst they are wholly within 8" of any units with this ability that do not have the Supersonic ability.

orbital-strike-augur.name: Orbital Strike Augur
orbital-strike-augur.text: Once per battle, at the start of any Orders phase, you can search through your Command Asset deck and draw one Orbital Strike Command Asset card. Add the drawn card to your hand, then shuffle the Command Asset deck and place it face down.

shield-gate-barriers.name: Shield Gate Barriers
shield-gate-barriers.text: Add 1 to saving throws made for INFANTRY, DREADNOUGHT and BIKE units whilst they are on a Realm of Battle tile with a friendly Tacticus Bunker unit.

command-relay.name: Command Relay
command-relay.text: At the start of the Generate Command Assets step, if any models from your army that have any Communication Relays are on the battlefield, draw one extra Command Asset.

haywire-mine.name: Haywire Mine

multi-spectrum-gunsights.name: Multi-spectrum Gunsights
multi-spectrum-gunsights.text: Do not apply negative modifiers to hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons by this unit.

lancer-aquilon-optics.name: Lancer Aquilon Optics
lancer-aquilon-optics.text: Each time this model makes an attack with a Lancer Laser Destroyer, add 1 to that attack's hit roll.

relic-shield.name: Relic Shield
relic-shield.text: If this unit has a Relic Shield, it has a Save characteristic of 4+.

deeds-of-heroism.name: Deeds of Heroism
deeds-of-heroism.text: While a friendly <CHAPTER> BLADEGUARD unit is within 6" of this model, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to that attack's hit roll.

storm-shield.name: Storm Shield
storm-shield.text: If this unit has a Storm Shield, it has a Save characteristic of 5+.

tempormortis.name: Tempormortis
tempormortis.text:
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by enemy units
that target this unit.

devastating-charge.name: Devastating Charge
devastating-charge.text: When this unit makes a Fight Action, if it has not remained stationary or Piled In this turn, double it's Attacks characteristic for that action.

total-obliteration.name: Total Obliteration
total-obliteration.text: When this unit's detachment carries out the Aimed Fire order and this unit makes a Shoot action, double its Attacks characteristic and the Attacks Characteristic of any Multi-meltas it is equipped with for that action.

defensive-array.name: Defensive Array
defensive-array.text: When this unit makes a Shoot action, its Hammerfall Heavy Bolter Array or its Hammerfall Heavy Flamer Array may target, and resolve attacks against, every eligible enemy unit.

wrecker.name: Wrecker
wrecker.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit with melee weapons if it is equipped with 2 Ironclad Combat Weapons.

litanies-of-hate.name: Litanies of Hate
litanies-of-hate.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly <CHAPTER> units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

spiritual-leader.name: Spiritual Leader
spiritual-leader.text: Friendly <CHAPTER> units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

rites-of-battle.name: Rites of Battle
rites-of-battle.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly <CHAPTER> units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

blessing-of-the-omnissiah.name: Blessing of the Omnissiah
blessing-of-the-omnissiah.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair one friendly <CHAPTER> VEHICLE unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that VEHICLE unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

company-heroes.name: Company Heroes
company-heroes.text: Each HQ slot in a Detachment allows you to take up to two of this unit in your army, instead of one. Each unit taken for a single HQ slot must be placed at the same time and within 6" of each other unit taken for the same slot the first time they are set up.

tactical-precision.name: Tactical Precision
tactical-precision.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly <CHAPTER> units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

narthecium.name: Narthecium
narthecium.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to heal one friendly <CHAPTER> LIGHT unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that LIGHT unit. Only one attempt to heal each unit can be made each turn.

astartes-banner.name: Astartes Banner
astartes-banner.text: Morale tests taken for friendly <CHAPTER> units are automatically passed whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

honour-or-death.name: Honour or Death
honour-or-death.text: You can re-roll wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit that target CHARACTER units.

command-squad-bodyguard.name: Command Squad Bodyguard
command-squad-bodyguard.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can select one friendly <CHAPTER> LIGHT CHARACTER unit that has at least one blast marker next to it and is within 6" of this unit. Remove up to D3 blast markers from that CHARACTER unit and place them next to this unit.

chapter-banner.name: Chapter Banner
chapter-banner.text: Morale tests taken for friendly <CHAPTER> units are automatically passed whilst they are within 9" of this unit.

drop-pod-assault.name: Drop Pod Assault
drop-pod-assault.text: After this unit is set up on the battlefield, units embarked aboard it must immediately disembark, and units cannot embark aboard it for the rest of the battle. Units disembarking from this unit cannot be set up within 9" of any enemy units. If a unit embarked aboard this unit cannot disembark, it is destroyed.

hover-jet.name: Hover Jet
hover-jet.text: At the start of the Action phase, you can declare that this unit will hover. If it does, then until the end of the phase, its Move characteristic changes to 20" but it loses the Supersonic ability.

void-shields.name: Void Shields
void-shields.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can remove one blast marker from this unit. Small blast markers must be removed before large blast markers.

bulky.name: Bulky
bulky.text: This model cannot embark aboard a TRANSPORT.

skyborne-predator.name: Skyborne Predator
skyborne-predator.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit that target units that can FLY.

tarantula-battery.name: Tarantula Battery
tarantula-battery.text: Each Fast Attack slot in a Detachment allows you to take up to three of this unit in your army, instead of one. Each unit taken for a single Fast Attack slot must be placed at the same time and within 6" of each other unit taken for the same slot the first time they are set up.

realm-of-battle.name: Realm of Battle
realm-of-battle.text: This unit is a feature of a Realm of Battle tile, and as such forms part of the battlefield. Once the tile has been placed, this unit it treated as an Obstacle and is not considered to be a unit for any rules purposes until the first turn begins. When this unit is destroyed it is not removed from the battlefield: instead it is treated as a Defensible Terrain feature and is not considered to be a unit for any rules purposes.

astartes-banner-2.name: Astartes Banner
astartes-banner-2.text: Morale tests taken for friendly <CHAPTER> units are automatically passed whilst they are within 9" of this unit.
